outcome: self-efficacy to communicate with a partner
self-efficacy to plan for protected sex and avoid unprotected sex
self-efficacy regarding where to get methods of birth control
cohort: 1,036 ethnically diverse youths aged 13-18 years, recruited from 44 residential group homes in three states.
finding: The PTC intervention group showed significant long-term improvements in knowledge and self-efficacy related to sexual health, HIV/STIs, and contraception methods compared to the control group.
